title: Generally Strong
author: Lukas M.
desc: Generally Strong template based on Cody Lefever's General Gainz framework. 6 week cycle. Slight variations. Read General Gainz to understand the 4 actions.

ex.note: For all  T1-exercises in Workout A: Push Singles to Doubles when 5RM+8 Singles are achieved, then push to 6RM. When 6RM occurs, push it to Workout B and reset to heavier weight in Workout A.
Weight increase need not be all the way back to a 3RM, but 3RM development is not discouraged. Same weight for RM and Singles/Doubles
Keep rest low in follow up sets. If follow ups become difficult after a 5-6RM, build more strength-endurance
For T3s: 3-4 sets. Add weight when easily hitting 10 reps each set.
For all  T1-exercises in Workout A: Push Singles to Doubles when 5RM+8 Singles are achieved, then push to 6RM. When 6RM occurs, push it to Workout B and reset to heavier weight in Workout A.
T3: Increase weight when hitting 10 reps each set
T2 exercise: target 6-10 reps, followed by half sets. Push RM when 6 half sets are achieved. Increase weight when 10RM and 6 half sets are achieved.
T3: add weight when hitting upper rep range on each set
T3: Add weight when 15 reps achieved each set
